ConceptPage.title: The idea
ConceptPage.metaDescription: The story behind SVOLTA — a plant-forward kitchen in Bangkok born from 35 countries of eating well.
ConceptPage.intro: SVOLTA means 'turn' in Italian. A shift in direction. Here, it's a kitchen that turns away from excess.
ConceptPage.section1Body: We cook vegetables, legumes, and grains with the same care usually reserved for meat. No labels, no manifesto — just food that tastes like what it is.
ConceptPage.section2Body: When an ingredient is at its best, it appears. When its season ends, it disappears. The menu is short because it should be: only what's worth cooking right now.
ConceptPage.section3Body: Every part of every ingredient has a role. Trimmings become stocks, stalks become garnishes. We plan to waste as little as possible.
